senses.sense_definition: A seemingly self-evident or necessary truth which is based on assumption; a principle or proposition which cannot actually be proved or disproved.

examples.text: Any publicity, runs the <w>axiom</w>, is good publicity.
Can we then find <w>axioms</w> as self-evident as those of arithmetic, on which we can build a sure foundation?

senses.sense_definition: A fundamental assumption that serves as a basis for deduction of theorems; a <w>postulate</w>.

examples.text: Geometry is a system where the definitions are clear and the <w>axioms</w> cannot be denied.
The <w>axioms</w> of the formal system define how each object interacts with the others.

senses.sense_definition: An established principle in some artistic practice or science that is universally received.

examples.text: The <w>axioms</w> of political economy cannot be considered absolute truths in every situation.
He followed the <w>axiom</w> that there is no offence in blue stockings provided the petticoats are long enough.
